inputs.label: Your own Xenowerk 2.0.7 iOS .ipa file (the recompiled game only works with that version).

prepare.label: Building the game from your IPA (the first time it downloads about 115 MB of tools and takes a few minutes)

exit_codes.1: The launcher couldn't read your IPA. Pick it again on the game's page.
exit_codes.2: That file isn't a valid IPA. Pick your Xenowerk 2.0.7 .ipa file.
exit_codes.3: That IPA has no game inside (Payload/*.app). Pick your Xenowerk 2.0.7 .ipa file.
exit_codes.14: Unpacking the game failed: the IPA looks damaged or the drive is full.
exit_codes.16: Unpacking the game failed: the IPA uses a compression this version can't read.
exit_codes.17: Unpacking the game failed: couldn't write the files. Check the free space on the drive.
exit_codes.20: Couldn't download the build tools. Check your internet connection and press Set Up again.
exit_codes.21: A build tool download was damaged. Press Set Up again.
exit_codes.22: Translating the game's code failed. Make sure you picked the Xenowerk 2.0.7 .ipa file.
exit_codes.23: Compiling the game failed. Press Copy and send the lines on the XenoRecomp issues page.
exit_codes.24: Not enough free space on the game's drive (about 1.5 GB is needed for the build).
exit_codes.25: This install is incomplete (the recomp folder is missing). Reinstall XenoRecomp.
exit_codes.27: The setup step failed. Press Copy and send the lines on the XenoRecomp issues page.
